findings.description: The rounding condition fails for exact half-cent ties (remainder equals 5).
findings.evidence: The contract requires 'exact half-cent ties rounded upward'. For input mills=25, divmod(25, 10) yields quotient=2 and remainder=5. The expression (remainder > 5) evaluates to False, returning 2 instead of the required 3. The condition should be (remainder >= 5) to satisfy the specification.

review.summary: The candidate incorrectly rounds exact half-cent ties downward instead of upward, violating the rounding rule in the specification.
